name: Running Circle
author: Addicting Games
description: Running Circle is an online clicker game that you can play from your phone or computer. This is a simple online game with clean animation in just two colors. This game may not have fancy graphics but it sure will keep you busy for hours. Just because it is easy on the eyes, though, does not mean it is an easy-to-beat game. This online game requires fast reflexes to get the best possible score. Your objective is to avoid running into a white line. Seems too simple, right? While you are trying to avoid one white wall, another one will appear as the white ball keeps quickly spinning around the circle. This is the type of game to play again and again. Play to defeat your own best score as well as to rise up the scoreboards.
